lenses.description: The wide end of Thypoch's ultracompact Simera-C full-frame cine set, derived from the company's Simera rangefinder-style photo primes but built around a rounded 16-blade iris for smoother, onion-ring-free bokeh. It pairs an environmental wide perspective with a bright constant aperture and a moderately high-contrast rendering, and its tiny size makes the set one of the few that fit gimbals like the DJI Ronin 4D for low-angle, over-the-shoulder and tight-interior work.

lenses.description: The ultra-wide of Thypoch's ultracompact Simera-C full-frame cine set, adding a sweeping perspective with good distortion control in a body small enough for gimbals, drones and handheld rigs. It shares the set's low-saturation coating for consistent colour across lenses, a 16-blade iris for smooth bokeh and symmetrical sunstars, and focuses very close for dramatic near-far compositions.

lenses.description: The telephoto that completes Thypoch's seven-lens Simera-C full-frame cine set, bringing tighter portraits and gentle compression to a compact, lightweight line built for gimbal and handheld work. It keeps the set's colour-matched low-saturation coating, creamy bokeh from a 16-blade iris and consistent gear positions, and shares its filter size with the 75mm.
